items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Preorders Are Now Live, Includes Standard & Collector's Editions
items.summary: Square Enix has launched preorders for Final Fantasy XIV Evercold, which arrives in February 2027. Get more details here.
items.content:
Pre-orders for the Standard and Collector’s Editions of the Final Fantasy XIV expansion, Evercold, have gone live ahead of its highly anticipated launch on February 23, 2027. You can purchase it as a collector’s bundle, which includes a digital version of the game but only on PC, which is a little odd considering the whole point of no disc was to include digital codes for the other systems. The Collector’s Box, which is just the physical merchandise, has also launched. At the time of writing, the EU/UK versions are now live, with the NA store getting the box added later on in the day at 10AM PST.

The bundles in the UK are £239.99 for the Collector’s Box and £289.99 for the Collector’s Bundle, which for some reason is a different button for PC/MAC, so make sure you pick the correct one. Also, this is not a Steam code. If you are on a PC and wish to purchase the Steam version, make sure to buy the box and then buy the Collector’s Edition separately.

In addition, the console versions are sold separately too, so you will need to visit the PSN Store if you wish to purchase the standard or collectors edition of Evercold. However, note that the licence for the game is not shared, and you will need to purchase the expansion on any platforms you play on, the items are so you only need to purchase the Collectors Edition once if you do own the game on several platforms.

The digital collectors edition that you get when either buying the bundle or on its own, will include the following:

If you preorder any edition before February 23, you will gain access to the following:

If you get the pre-order in, then you will gain access to Evercold around 9AM GMT (subject to change also please convert to your local timezone) on February 19, rather than February 23. The earring also continues the trend of EXP increasing items; this item will give you +30% EXP from enemies you defeat as you level up to 100. Plus, the Wind-up Köttr Minion I feel like is going to be a fan favourite with a heap of players simply due to how adorable it is. For more details on Everrcold, be sure to check out our recent Fanfest coverage here.

The God of War Laufey release date has been delayed. Sony Santa Monica Studio confirmed the game will now ship on May 20, 2027.

items.title: Wisdom of Nym: Reacting to Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold’s final reveals in Tokyo
Final Fantasy 14: Evercold sets itself a release date at the tail end of winter, alongside offering a look at its second, avian-inclined new job
items.summary: And it's coming slightly later than expected.
items.content:
Image credit: Square Enix News by Oisin Kuhnke Contributor Published on Nov. 1, 2026, 6:07 p.m. 1 comment Follow Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn - Collector's Edition Let's start with the bad news: Final Fantasy 14: Evercold has been delayed. The good news, that doesn't matter all that much, as it's only a delay of roughly a month, and a release date has been set in stone too: February 23rd, 2027. It's cutting it a bit close to the seasons shifting towards spring, making the game seasonally inappropriate, but hey ho, February is still winter!

That release date was revealed during this week's Final Fantasy 14 Fest Fest held in Tokyo. It was paired with a big ole cinematic that'll open up the expansion when you do actually get to play it. You can watch that down below if you fancy, that'll just depend on whether you want to go into the expansion knowing as little as possible. Looks pretty at least! I like the big dragony ship we've seen previously .

The expansion's second new job has been revealed too. It's called Zephyr, a physical ranged DPS that uses a crossbow and comes with its own avian familiar to assist you in battle. Seems like a pretty good option for folks afraid of getting in close but want to get some damage in. The bird friend you get is neat too. I hereby request that every other job gets a bird friend! I don't care if it doesn't make sense!

Most annoyingly, for me personally as someone that's only managed to play A Realm Reborn and doesn't really have time to go through a ridiculous number of hours and expansions just to get to this one, a preview for the Evangelion collab alliance raid was shown off rendered in the style of the original anime's post-credits, next episode teaser reels . I love those dang big robots and feelings of depression, don't make me go through all those expansions just to let my Viera dress up as Asuka or whatever loot you end up getting.

Anyway, don't forget to mark your calendars, February 23rd! Be there or be, uh, anywhere else I guess. I'm not your boss.

items.title: Yoshida’s Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold Delay Throws It Into the Busiest Month of Early 2027, Launching the Same Day as Fable
items.summary: Square's Naoki Yoshida announced a delay for Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold. The expansion now launches in February, alongside many other games.
items.content:
Square Enix has delayed Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold from its original January 2027 release window to February 23, 2027 , and that new date puts the MMORPG's sixth expansion right in the middle of what's shaping up to be one of the most crowded months for game releases in recent memory .

Just look at the stiff competition: February 2027 opens with Metro 2039 on February 4, then Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis arrives on February 12, God of War Laufey and Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United drop on February 16, and Persona 4 Revival launches on February 18. Evercold's pre-order early access begins the very next day, on February 19 , and its full launch on February 23 coincides with Playground Games' long-awaited Fable reboot. Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories and Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity – Definitive Edition follow on February 25, and just a few days into March, there are also Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember (March 4) and Gundam Rogue Orbit (March 5). It's a veritable bloodbath for gamers.

To be fair, Final Fantasy XIV's audience is about as dedicated as they come , with the MMORPG now passing 35 million registered accounts . But even its most loyal players may struggle to find the time for everything else arriving that month.

Producer and director Naoki Yoshida announced the delay during the Final Fantasy XIV Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo . According to Yoshida, the team was committed to the January window and was even just barely on track to meet it, but quality concerns led him to give the expansion three extra weeks of development . He even bowed in apology on stage for missing the original target.

It is a short delay by most standards, to be sure, but a notable one for a live service game. Evercold will be the first new expansion since Dawntrail in July 2024, and it will also be the first released for the Switch 2 version, which launched on August 4 .

The keynote also revealed Zephyr, the second of Evercold's two new jobs. In the words of Square Enix's press release:

A physical ranged DPS, the Zephyr joins the fray using a combination of crossbow shots and support from an avian familiar known as Nephele.

Beyond the new job, Yoshida outlined a meaty list of changes and additions. Evercold adds new areas in the Icebound Realm of the Fourth, a new difficulty called Fierce that sits between Normal and Savage, and a new Seasons reward system that significantly changes how item rewards are obtained . There is also an Evolved Combat Mode , described as a new way to play that highlights each job’s unique identity, along with improved character creation and Character Action Skins.

On the raid side, Square Enix showed new artwork by Tetsuya Nomura for Beyond the Lifestream , the upcoming crossover raid series with the Final Fantasy VII Remake series, and a new trailer for EVANGELION: Ghosts of Desire , an alliance raid crossover that will also get high-difficulty eight-player battles featuring its bosses . Patch 8.1 will then bring expanded housing, PvP updates, and a revamped companion chocobo system. Players who want to try the new character creation options early can do so in a benchmark planned for December.

Pre-orders open on November 4 at 9:00 AM GMT and include early access starting February 19, a Wind-Up Köttr minion, and Halone's Earring, which grants a 30% EXP bonus from defeating enemies . Since the in-game items are delivered immediately upon pre-order, players can use the earring to level their jobs to 100 well ahead of Evercold's launch.

The Digital Collector's Edition adds the Valhallar Odin mount, the Entreat Crystal emote, and the Crystal Skyltborg: Bastion weapon. There's also a physical Collector's Box , featuring an art box with an Evercold illustration by Yoshitaka Amano , a reaper Warrior of Light figure, a metal keychain, a Köttr mini plush, and a tapestry. As with the GTA VI collection we covered recently , though, the box doesn't include a copy of the game, in-game items, or pre-order bonuses. The Collector's Box costs $255 on its own, while the Collector's Bundle , which pairs it with the Digital Collector's Edition for Windows or Mac, costs $319.99 , over $100 more than its Dawntrail equivalent.

Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold launches on February 23, 2027 , for PC, Mac, Steam, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series S|X, and Nintendo Switch 2. For newcomers, the Free Trial now includes everything through Shadowbringers and patch 5.58, without a playtime limit .

About the author : With over two decades of experience in gaming journalism, Alessio Palumbo has led the gaming vertical at Wccftech since August 2015. He started working at a young age for Italian websites like Everyeye.it, Gamestar.it, Nextgame.it, and Multiplayer.it before kickstarting the indie English-language publication Worlds Factory as its founder and Editor in Chief. In the last decade, he has coordinated the overall output of Wccftech's gaming section, managed PR relations, assigned reviews, produced daily news coverage, edited gaming content as needed, and delivered game reviews. Arguably, his trademark content is the long series of exclusive developer interviews that have been cited by Wikipedia and by the biggest news media and gaming publications. His passion for technology also makes him knowledgeable when it comes to gaming hardware and tech. His favorite genres include RPGs, MMORPGs, and action/adventure games.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14's next job is a crossbow-wielding ranged DPS with a bird sidekick
items.summary: Final Fantasy 14: Evercold's second new job is zephyr, a crossbow-wielding ranged DPS with a bird sidekick. The expansion launches on 23rd February 2027.
items.content:
Plus Square Enix confirms Final Fantasy 14 has passed 35m registered accounts.

Image credit: Square Enix News by Vikki Blake Contributor Published on Oct. 31, 2026, 2:39 p.m. 2 comments Follow Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold Prioritise us on Google Final Fantasy 14 's next expansion, Evercold, will launch on 23rd February 2027, and its second new job is zephyr, a physical ranged DPS that fights with a crossbow and a bird.

Producer and director Naoki Yoshida revealed the job during the opening keynote of the Final Fantasy 14 Fan Festival 2026 in Tokyo. Zephyr pairs crossbow shots with support from an avian familiar called Nephele, and joins Bastion, the greatshield-wielding tank revealed as Evercold's first new job at Fan Festival Berlin earlier this year.

Pre-orders for Evercold and the previously announced Collector's Box open on Wednesday 4th November at 9am GMT. Anyone who pre-orders gets early access, plus a Wind-Up Köttr minion and Halone's Earring, which boosts EXP from defeating enemies by 30 percent. The in-game items are delivered as soon as you pre-order, so you can use the earring to level jobs before Evercold arrives.

The Collector's Box is physical goods only. It doesn't include the game, in-game items or pre-order bonuses. Inside you'll find an art box featuring an Evercold illustration by Yoshitaka Amano, a figure of the Warrior of Light as a reaper, an Ethos metal keychain, a Köttr mini plush, and a Tapestry of the Fourth.

The Square Enix Store is also selling a limited Collector's Bundle that pairs the box with a code for the Digital Collector's Edition on Windows or Mac. Players on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X/S, Switch 2 , and Steam can buy the box on its own and pre-order the Digital Collector's Edition separately. The digital edition adds a Valhallar Odin mount, an Entreat Crystal emote, and a Crystal Skyltborg weapon for Bastion.

Square Enix also used the keynote to reveal a new Fierce raid difficulty, sitting between Normal and Savage; a new trailer for the Evangelion: Ghosts of Desire alliance raid crossover, plus tougher eight-player battles built around some of its bosses; and new Tetsuya Nomura artwork for Beyond the Lifestream, a raid series crossover with the Final Fantasy 7 Remake series.

We can also expect Evolved Combat Mode, which Square Enix says highlights each job's unique identity; Seasons, a new system that changes how item rewards are earned; and expanded character creation with new Character Action Skins. Expanded housing features, PvP updates, and a revamped companion chocobo system will follow from patch 8.1.

Final Fantasy 14 has passed 35 million registered accounts.

You can watch the full keynote on Twitch , and there's more on the official Evercold site .

Final Fantasy 14 is now available on Switch 2 . The port was announced at the end of June .

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Evercold Delayed at Tokyo Fan Fest
items.summary: Producer Naoki Yoshida pushed Evercold back over quality concerns
items.content:
By Josh Broadwell Published Oct 31, 2026, 9:27 AM EDT Josh is a critic, reporter, and guide writer who covers a broad range of topics, though he specializes in narrative-driven games. He's written for some of the biggest brands in publishing, including Rolling Stone, RogerEbert.com, NPR, and Wired, and he also freelances as a video game consultant. News Producer Naoki Yoshida explains why Evercold has been pushed back

Image: Square Enix Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Sign in to your Polygon.com account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread 2 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Square Enix has delayed Final Fantasy XIV Evercold 's release date, producer Naoki Yoshida announced during the Fan Fest Tokyo event, but it's not a big delay. The MMO's expansion was originally planned for a late January launch , but Yoshida decided to delay the launch by three weeks.

Evercold 's early access launch is now set for Feb. 19, and the full launch is Feb. 23. Pre-orders begin on Nov. 4. Yoshida said the expansion's essential features were progressing smoothly, but he decided to delay for quality.

"We were on track to just barely get the game to you in the stated frame," Yoshida said. "This is being done to make sure we can deliver on the many promises we've made. We appreciate your understanding as we near the finish line."

That the team needed extra time to ensure quality isn't too surprising. Evercold will introduce a number of features new to Final Fantasy XIV , including a more open progression system for main story quests where you can pursue questlines in a less linear fashion. There's also an auto-balance adjustment system that helps ensure enemy level and duty difficulty scales to match everyone's level, in case players joining a duty are at different levels.

Evercold also changes FFXIV 's progression from daily to weekly so folks have more flexibility. If you can't play for a few days, you aren't missing out, and you can even go back and earn reward points from previous weeks if you weren't able to complete them for some reason. And Evercold adds the new Evolved battle style aimed at streamlining combat, which Yoshida said the team is still tweaking it for all the non- Evercold jobs and role actions. Square Enix is planning a whole Live Letter dedicated to how Evolved mode works sometime before Evercold 's launch.

Anyway, it's a lot to get right, and it's definitely not a set of features you'd want to launch in a buggy state.

As with previous expansions, you'll be able to start playing Evercold from the early access date only if you have an active subscription, pre-ordered Evercold , and registered the pre-order bonus code ahead of the early access launch date.

Final Fantasy XIV is available on Mac, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows PC, and Xbox Series X.

items.summary: New job and much more revealed
items.content:
Now that the MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV Online is available on the Switch 2, Square Enix is looking towards the game's sixth expansion, Evercold .

We previously heard how it would be coming in January 2027, and now at the Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest in Tokyo this weekend, Square Enix has announced the date has been shifted to 23rd February 2027 . Pre-orders will begin on 4th November 2026 , with early access opening on 19th February 2027 .

As previously confirmed, it will come with new jobs, cities, areas, dungeons, trials, new areas, a level cap increase and much more. Joining the Bastion job is the new physical ranged DPS, Zephyr. You can find out more about what's included in Evercold in our previous story and on the FFXIV YouTube channel .

Keybound Brawler, a new event that tests your typing prowess, is coming to the Manderville Gold Saucer! The first iteration of the event will be a special collaboration with the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE series. items.title: Several Final Fantasy XIV Modding Communities Have Banned Popular NSFW Modder
items.summary: The bans came after modder Noffletoff was credibly accused of participating in graphic discussions of illegal content
items.content:
Several major Final Fantasy XIV modding communities have taken steps to remove the work of a popular not-safe-for-work mod creator after chat logs were exposed in which the modder was seen participating in graphic discussions of illegal material.

Content warning for discussion of child abuse sexual assault material (CSAM)

On YouTube, a user identified as Chunni Doll posted a video alleging that modder Noffletoff, along with several other Final Fantasy XIV players, was engaged in the discussion and sharing of CSAM. The video claims that the chats took place in an invite-only chat room that was part of a larger Matrix server centered on loli/shotacon content. (Sometimes described as an alternative to Discord, Matrix servers are decentralized servers that allow for real-time communication.)

The video was accompanied by a Proton document in which screenshots of the chatlogs are displayed. Kotaku has reviewed the document, and while direct references to victims’ names and explicit descriptions of CSAM content have been censored, the alleged participants can be seen making references to content they’ve watched and potentially sharing content with users on another platform called Session. Matrix administrators were made aware of the server and it was shut down and the alleged participants banned.

Noffletoff is the creator of several paid Final Fantasy XI V body and animation mods that are widely used to create NSFW FFXIV content. As a result of these allegations, numerous FFXIV modding communities are purging his work from their platforms. Additionally, Noffletoff’s Patreon and X account have been deleted.

The Final Fantasy XIV Mod Archive (XMA), one of the largest hosting sites of FFXIV mods, has banned the account associated with Noffletoff. Kotaku has reviewed messages sent in the XMA Discord server confirming Noffletoff’s suspension, a decision announced by a moderator after a user asked what would be done in light of the allegations. “I think it’s reasonable at this point to go ahead and suspend Noff’s account (and have done so),” the post read.

Kotaku has also reviewed messages in Booty Bay, a Discord server associated with pirating FFXIV mods. The moderators of that Discord server have taken similar action, removing his mods from their repositories while banning them from future uploads and banning all discussions related to the allegations against Noffletoff. Snowcloak, a Final Fantasy XIV mod program that allows users to view other players’ mods in game, will block the display of Noffletoff’s mods. “Users attempting to use these mods will receive a warning that the file is blocked,” read a message from a Snowcloak moderator, according to screenshots from the server reviewed by Kotaku .

According to the video, the alleged participants have been reported to authorities. Kotaku has reached out to Square Enix for comment.
